This completes the API boundary for the existing 22-obligation fixed contract; the affine arm stays separate. `canonical_chart(descriptor)` accepts exactly p,a,b,k,target,t,s,arm,stratum. # Full-chart quadratic composition

Full-chart composition design, 2026-11-01. Root source inspection and algebraic design only; UNREVIEWED and UNEXECUTED. This does not alter the prepared correction or its prospective tests.

For a fixed public nonsingular short Weierstrass curve over prime p>3, k<=5 and fixed target T, use the existing chart_spec pole degree d=k+[T finite]. Handle k0 and d1 explicitly. For each nontrivial pole chart, project exactly the lower normalized pole-basis coefficients of A(X)+B(X)y; the highest pole term has coefficient1. Introduce monic U of degree k as auxiliary coefficients. Enforce A^2-f B^2=c U for T=O, or A^2-f B^2=c(X-x_T)U for finite T, where c=1 at even d and -1 at odd d. Each coefficient equation has total degree at most2 in these unknowns. For finite T add the linear sign equation A(x_T)-y_T B(x_T)=0, so the function vanishes at -T. Degree and leading coefficient conditions must match validate_shape exactly, including zero/constant/linear B strata.

Retain U as a lifted variable at first. Although solving the norm equations expresses its coefficients quadratically in A/B, substituting those expressions into a modular product constraint involving U*Q can create cubic terms. Removing k variables is therefore not automatically a degree improvement. Treat any U-elimination arm as a separately specified tradeoff, not part of the base quadratic builder.

For interval membership, add degree<k idempotents e_j and explicit polynomial quotient witnesses for e_j^2-e_j divisible by U. Define N=X-t-sum(2^j e_j) mod U and enforce N^k=0 with the same quadratic modular-product lifting mechanism. The interval proof is the existing quotient-witness construction, including nilpotent repeated-root handling, not the stronger and incorrect demand N=0. Keep the zero quotient k0 case separate. All modular quotient coefficient bounds must be retained, including zeros.

Compose rationality using the existing uniform nilpotent-square block or declared zero/constant/linear B strata. The nilpotent condition is (C^2-f)^k=0 modulo U, not C^2=f modulo U. This distinction preserves branch roots and repeated support. At linear B, use the existing guard or slack equations; at constant nonzero B, retain its inverse condition. Zero-B needs the nilpotent block. Preserve finite-target subtraction and signed multiplicity recovery after decoding; a group sum alone is not the existing chart certificate.

Authentication composition proposal: a new trusted public chart descriptor builds the entire symbolic source, including normalized pole chart, interval width, stratum and source variable ordering. Merge blocks by explicit variable renaming and role assignment, turning component u inputs into the shared auxiliary U. Authenticate this canonical aggregate before bit compilation. The current range compiler can be reused through its trusted generic range-descriptor API: derive that descriptor internally from the chart builder, then invoke the existing transcript completion. Never accept the generic arithmetic descriptor from an untrusted submitted chart as if it authenticated the mathematics. Charge both chart construction and range authentication if the composition reconstructs them twice. Any cached trust token would require a separate binding design.

The decisive fixed validation is original checked chart -> supplied auxiliary assignment -> aggregate field residuals -> compiled Boolean residuals -> decoded chart -> unchanged signed checker. Preserve all15 existing chart fixtures and all three rationality arms, impossible strata, both F1 beta signs, characteristic-sized multiplicity, two-torsion, target outside the interval and wrapped interval. Separately compare the complete projected model sets once the solver contract is admitted. Fixed witness roundtrips alone do not establish model-set completeness.

Internal primary sources inspected: research/prime_sat_shared_signed_chart_20261030/charts.py (chart_spec, basis, constructor), quotient.py (verify_quotient_witness), signed_recovery.py (validate_shape and recover_signed_divisor), and research/prime_sat_rationality_software_20261031/circuits.py and rationality.py (explicit sparse builder and modular-product/rationality blocks). These are source-derived design obligations; no new mathematical or performance status is promoted. No canonical graph changes. The corrected compiler is the prerequisite; full-chart implementation proceeds under its own task.

For impossible k0/finite-target or pole-one charts, a future algebraic compiler can emit the constant equation1=0 with its literal constant certificate, rather than silently omit a required chart. The all-identity chart has one empty assignment only when T=O. These special cases require their own prospective controls.

Projection comparison boundary: the three rationality arms of this chart construction can share the same normalized coefficient projection. A quartic baseline projecting ordered coordinates does not automatically have that same raw projected set. A cross-representation comparison must specify an exact common signed-output convention and a checked bijection or complete fiber extractor; do not equate differing raw bit projections. Preserve the original identical-projection requirement for encodings that claim the same projection.

"""Canonical field-to-Boolean compilation and range-only proof completion.

Prime p is a caller premise. No solver, field census or assignment-specialized
construction is used. Generic descriptors bind caller arithmetic; compile_block
additionally binds the reviewed rationality builder. Authentication is separate
from witness evaluation. All costs are counts in named, separate phases.
"""
from collections import Counter
from copy import deepcopy
from functools import lru_cache
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


@lru_cache(None)
def load(path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_range_' + Path(path).stem, ROOT / path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def adapter():
    return load('research/prime_sat_prefix_adapter_20261030/adapter.py')


def authenticated():
    return load('research/prime_sat_rationality_authenticated_20261031/authenticated.py')


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def integer(x, minimum=0):
    require(type(x) is int and x >= minimum, 'canonical integer required')
    return x


def encoded(x):
    return json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode()


def digest(x):
    return hashlib.sha256(encoded(x)).hexdigest()


def same(a, b, counts):
    counts['nodes'] += 1
    if type(a) is not type(b):
        return False
    if type(a) is dict:
        return a.keys() == b.keys() and all(same(a[k], b[k], counts) for k in a)
    if type(a) is list:
        return len(a) == len(b) and all(same(x, y, counts) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return a == b


def fields(x, keys):
    require(type(x) is dict and set(x) == set(keys), 'exact mapping schema required')


def poly(x, p, n):
    require(type(x) is dict, 'polynomial mapping required')
    out = {}
    for k, c in x.items():
        require(type(k) is str and re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*', k), 'canonical mask string required')
        require(int(k).bit_length() <= n, 'mask outside ring')
        require(integer(c, 1) < p, 'canonical nonzero residue required')
        out[k] = c
    return out


def sparse(terms, p, counts):
    out = {}
    for m, c in terms:
        counts['coefficient_merges'] += 1
        if m in out:
            counts['colliding_masks'] += 1
        out[m] = (out.get(m, 0) + c) % p
    counts['cancelled_output_terms'] += sum(c == 0 for c in out.values())
    return {str(m): c for m, c in sorted(out.items()) if c}


def substitute_equations(equations, layout, p, n):
    """Strict low-level substitution; callers supply trusted field equations."""
    integer(p, 2); integer(n)
    require(type(layout) is dict and type(equations) is list, 'equations/layout types')
    used = set()
    for name, positions in layout.items():
        require(type(name) is str and name and type(positions) is list, 'named bit list')
        require(len(positions) == (p-1).bit_length(), 'field bit width')
        for pos in positions:
            require(integer(pos) < n and pos not in used, 'unique in-ring value position')
            used.add(pos)
    costs = Counter(); output = []; labels = []
    for eq in equations:
        fields(eq, ('label', 'terms'))
        label = eq['label']
        require(type(label) is str and bool(label) and label not in labels, 'nonempty unique equation label')
        labels.append(label)
        require(type(eq['terms']) is list, 'term list')
        seen = set(); terms = []; previous = None
        for term in eq['terms']:
            fields(term, ('coefficient', 'variables'))
            c, vs = term['coefficient'], term['variables']
            require(integer(c, 1) < p, 'canonical field coefficient')
            require(type(vs) is list and all(type(v) is str and v in layout for v in vs), 'known field variables')
            require(len(vs) <= 2 and vs == sorted(vs), 'canonical degree at most two')
            monomial = tuple(vs)
            require(monomial not in seen and (previous is None or previous < monomial), 'canonical ordered unique terms')
            seen.add(monomial); previous = monomial
            expansion = [(0, c)]
            for name in vs:
                next_terms = []
                for mask, coefficient in expansion:
                    for j, bit in enumerate(layout[name]):
                        costs['products'] += 1
                        next_terms.append((mask | (1 << bit), coefficient * (1 << j) % p))
                expansion = next_terms
            terms.extend(expansion)
            costs['source_terms'] += 1
        output.append(sparse(terms, p, costs))
    return output, labels, dict(costs)


def compile_range(descriptor):
    """Authenticate layout and bind exact caller-supplied arithmetic content."""
    d = deepcopy(descriptor)
    fields(d, ('p', 'n', 'projected_bits', 'arithmetic', 'blocks'))
    p, n, m = integer(d['p'], 2), integer(d['n']), integer(d['projected_bits'])
    require(m <= n, 'projection outside ring')
    require(type(d['arithmetic']) is list and type(d['blocks']) is list, 'descriptor lists')
    arithmetic = [poly(x, p, n) for x in d['arithmetic']]
    b = (p-1).bit_length(); ones = [j for j in reversed(range(b)) if (p-1) >> j & 1]
    used = set(); names = set(); polynomials = deepcopy(arithmetic); generators = []; cnf = []; labels = []
    costs = Counter()
    for block in d['blocks']:
        fields(block, ('name', 'value_bits', 'state_bits'))
        name, values, states = block['name'], block['value_bits'], block['state_bits']
        require(type(name) is str and name and name not in names, 'unique field name')
        names.add(name)
        require(type(values) is list and len(values) == b, 'value width')
        require(type(states) is list and len(states) == len(ones)-1, 'state width')
        for pos in values + states:
            require(integer(pos) < n and pos not in used, 'duplicate/out-of-ring bit')
            used.add(pos)
        require(all(pos >= m for pos in states), 'state inside projection')
        s = [values[ones[0]]] + states
        rec = []
        for r in range(1, len(ones)):
            rec.append(len(polynomials))
            polynomials.append(sparse([(1 << s[r], 1), ((1 << s[r-1]) | (1 << values[ones[r]]), p-1)], p, costs))
            labels.append(name + ':recurrence:' + str(ones[r]))
        forbidden = []
        for j in range(b):
            if (p-1) >> j & 1:
                continue
            higher = [q for q in ones if q > j]
            r = len(higher)-1
            index = len(polynomials)
            polynomials.append({str((1 << s[r]) | (1 << values[j])): 1})
            labels.append(name + ':forbidden:' + str(j))
            forbidden.append({'local_bit': j, 'index': index, 'recurrences': rec[:r]})
            cnf.append([-(values[j]+1)] + [-(values[q]+1) for q in sorted(higher)])
        generators.append({'name': name, 'recurrences': rec, 'forbidden': forbidden})
    costs.update(blocks=len(d['blocks']), generators=len(polynomials)-len(arithmetic), clauses=len(cnf), literals=sum(map(len, cnf)))
    return {'schema': 'prime-range-compiler/v1', 'kind': 'range', 'descriptor': d,
            'p': p, 'n': n, 'projected_bits': m, 'blocks': deepcopy(d['blocks']),
            'polynomials': polynomials, 'range_labels': labels, 'generators': generators,
            'bootstrap_cnf': cnf, 'construction_costs': {'range': dict(costs)}}


def compile_block(public_descriptor):
    source = authenticated().canonical_circuit(deepcopy(public_descriptor))
    p = source['p']; b = (p-1).bit_length(); h = (p-1).bit_count()-1
    names = source['projection'] + source['auxiliaries']
    require(source['projection'] == source['inputs'] and len(set(names)) == len(names), 'source variable layout')
    m = b * len(source['projection']); total_values = b * len(names)
    blocks = [{'name': name, 'value_bits': list(range(i*b, (i+1)*b)),
               'state_bits': list(range(total_values+i*h, total_values+(i+1)*h))} for i, name in enumerate(names)]
    n = total_values + h*len(names)
    arithmetic, labels, substitution = substitute_equations(source['equations'], {x['name']: x['value_bits'] for x in blocks}, p, n)
    doc = compile_range({'p': p, 'n': n, 'projected_bits': m, 'arithmetic': arithmetic, 'blocks': blocks})
    doc.update(kind='block', public_descriptor=deepcopy(public_descriptor), source=deepcopy(source),
               source_sha256=digest(source), arithmetic_labels=labels,
               projection_decoding=[deepcopy(x) for x in blocks[:len(source['projection'])]])
    doc['construction_costs']['substitution'] = substitution
    doc['construction_costs']['source_authentication'] = {'canonical_builder_calls': 1, 'equations': len(labels), 'source_bytes': len(encoded(source))}
    return doc


def authenticate(document, trusted_descriptor, kind='block'):
    require(type(kind) is str and kind in ('block', 'range'), 'authentication kind')
    expected = compile_block(trusted_descriptor) if kind == 'block' else compile_range(trusted_descriptor)
    costs = Counter()
    require(same(document, expected, costs), 'canonical document content mismatch')
    return {'typed_comparison': dict(costs), 'construction': expected['construction_costs']}


def _encode_authenticated(document, assignment):
    """Private reconstruction core; the public caller authenticates first."""
    require(type(assignment) is dict and set(assignment) == {b['name'] for b in document['blocks']}, 'complete assignment required')
    counts = Counter()
    bits = 0; p = document['p']
    ones = [j for j in reversed(range((p-1).bit_length())) if (p-1) >> j & 1]
    counts['threshold_bit_visits'] = (p-1).bit_length()
    for block in document['blocks']:
        value = integer(assignment[block['name']]); require(value < p, 'noncanonical field assignment')
        counts['canonical_value_checks'] += 1
        for j, pos in enumerate(block['value_bits']):
            bits |= ((value >> j) & 1) << pos
            counts['value_bit_writes'] += 1
        state = (value >> ones[0]) & 1
        counts['initial_state_bit_reads'] += 1
        for j, pos in zip(ones[1:], block['state_bits']):
            state &= (value >> j) & 1
            bits |= state << pos
            counts['recurrence_products'] += 1
            counts['state_bit_writes'] += 1
    return {'bits': bits, 'costs': dict(counts)}


def encode_assignment_counted(document, assignment, trusted_descriptor, kind='block'):
    """Return canonical bits and separate successful-operation phase counts."""
    authentication = authenticate(document, trusted_descriptor, kind)
    result = _encode_authenticated(document, assignment)
    return {'bits': result['bits'], 'costs': {'authentication': authentication,
                                           'reconstruction': result['costs']}}


def encode_assignment(document, assignment, trusted_descriptor, kind='block'):
    """Integer-only compatibility API; measured callers use the counted API."""
    return encode_assignment_counted(document, assignment, trusted_descriptor, kind)['bits']


def decode_assignment(document, bits, trusted_descriptor, kind='block'):
    authentication = authenticate(document, trusted_descriptor, kind)
    require(integer(bits).bit_length() <= document['n'], 'assignment outside ring')
    result = {}; costs = Counter()
    for block in document['blocks']:
        result[block['name']] = sum(((bits >> pos) & 1) << j for j, pos in enumerate(block['value_bits']))
        costs['value_bit_reads'] += len(block['value_bits'])
    reconstructed = _encode_authenticated(document, result)
    state_mask = sum(1 << pos for block in document['blocks'] for pos in block['state_bits'])
    require((reconstructed['bits'] ^ bits) & state_mask == 0, 'noncanonical recurrence states')
    costs['state_bit_checks'] = state_mask.bit_count()
    return {'assignment': result, 'costs': {'authentication': authentication,
            'decoding': dict(costs), 'reconstruction': reconstructed['costs']}}


def range_certificate(document, depth, prefix):
    n, p = document['n'], document['p']
    require(integer(depth) <= n and integer(prefix).bit_length() <= depth, 'prefix outside ring')
    for block, gen in zip(document['blocks'], document['generators']):
        minimum = sum(((prefix >> pos) & 1) << j for j, pos in enumerate(block['value_bits']) if pos < depth)
        if minimum < p:
            continue
        j = (minimum ^ (p-1)).bit_length()-1
        info = next(x for x in gen['forbidden'] if x['local_bit'] == j)
        multipliers = [{} for _ in document['polynomials']]
        multipliers[info['index']] = {'0': 1}
        for index in info['recurrences']:
            multipliers[index] = {'0': p-1}
        return {'depth': depth, 'prefix': prefix, 'clause': adapter()._block(prefix, depth), 'certificate': multipliers}
    return None


def complete_transcript(document, trusted_descriptor, answer, kind='block', bootstrap_cnf=None):
    """Append domain proofs, retain invalid original records, never promote status.

Missing trie subtrees with a domain-valid minimum are reported as gaps without
exploring their Boolean cubes. Final acceptance belongs to the frozen adapter.
"""
    authentication = authenticate(document, trusted_descriptor, kind)
    raw = deepcopy(answer); augmented = deepcopy(answer)
    actual_cnf = deepcopy(document['bootstrap_cnf'] if bootstrap_cnf is None else bootstrap_cnf)
    counts = Counter(); comparison = Counter()
    require(same(actual_cnf, document['bootstrap_cnf'], comparison), 'bootstrap CNF content mismatch')
    output = {'original': raw, 'augmented': augmented, 'bootstrap_cnf': actual_cnf,
              'original_sha256': digest(raw), 'document_sha256': digest(document),
              'gaps': [], 'checker_result': None, 'failure': None,
              'costs': {'authentication': authentication, 'bootstrap_comparison': dict(comparison)}}
    try:
        require(type(raw) is dict and all(k in raw for k in ('status', 'models', 'learned')), 'answer fields')
        require(type(raw['models']) is list and type(raw['learned']) is list, 'answer lists')
        n, m, p = document['n'], document['projected_bits'], document['p']
        trie = {}; terminal = 'terminal'
        def insert(depth, prefix):
            require(integer(depth) <= n and integer(prefix).bit_length() <= depth, 'bounded prefix required')
            node = trie
            for i in range(depth):
                counts['insertion_bit_visits'] += 1
                node = node.setdefault((prefix >> i) & 1, {})
            node[terminal] = True
        for model in raw['models']:
            require(integer(model).bit_length() <= n, 'model outside ring')
            insert(m, model & ((1 << m)-1))
        for item in raw['learned']:
            require(type(item) is dict and 'depth' in item and 'prefix' in item, 'learned prefix fields')
            insert(item['depth'], item['prefix'])
        # Explicit enter/leave stack: one minima array and O(depth) undo state.
        positions = {pos: (i, 1 << j) for i, block in enumerate(document['blocks']) for j, pos in enumerate(block['value_bits'])}
        minima = [0] * len(document['blocks']); invalid = 0
        stack = [('visit', 0, 0, trie)]
        while stack:
            operation, depth, prefix, node = stack.pop()
            if operation in ('add', 'undo'):
                if depth in positions:
                    i, weight = positions[depth]; before = minima[i] >= p
                    minima[i] += weight if operation == 'add' else -weight
                    invalid += int(minima[i] >= p) - int(before)
                    counts['minimum_updates'] += 1
                continue
            counts['trie_visits'] += 1
            if terminal in node:
                continue
            if invalid:
                proof = range_certificate(document, depth, prefix)
                require(proof is not None, 'range certificate construction')
                augmented['learned'].append(proof)
                counts['emitted_certificates'] += 1
                counts['multiplier_vector_entries'] += len(proof['certificate'])
                counts['multiplier_nonzeros'] += sum(bool(x) for x in proof['certificate'])
                counts['certificate_serialization_bytes'] += len(encoded(proof))
                continue
            if not node or depth == n:
                output['gaps'].append({'depth': depth, 'prefix': prefix, 'zero_suffix_value_domain_witness': prefix,
                                       'arithmetic_root_asserted': False})
                continue
            stack.extend([('undo', depth, 0, None), ('visit', depth+1, prefix | (1 << depth), node.get(1, {})),
                          ('add', depth, 0, None), ('visit', depth+1, prefix, node.get(0, {}))])
        output['checker_result'] = adapter().verify_transcript(p, n, m, document['polynomials'], [], augmented, aux_bound=None)
        output['costs']['final_verifier'] = output['checker_result']['costs']
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError) as error:
        output['failure'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    output['costs']['completion'] = dict(counts)
    output['costs']['serialization'] = {'raw_bytes': len(encoded(raw)), 'augmented_bytes': len(encoded(augmented)), 'bootstrap_bytes': len(encoded(actual_cnf))}
    return output

"""Reviewed rationality blocks and supplied-witness construction, without relation search."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'prime_sat_shared_signed_chart_20261030'))
import quotient as q
import charts, projectors, signed_recovery
import circuits as ir

EVENTS = {}


def event(name):
    EVENTS[name] = EVENTS.get(name, 0)+1


def curve_parameters(p, a, b):
    q.require(type(p) is int and p > 3, 'prime p>3 premise')
    q.curve_data({'p': p, 'a': a, 'b': b})


def pad(poly, length, p):
    q.require(type(poly) is list and len(poly) <= length, 'bounded coefficient vector')
    for c in poly:
        q.scalar(c, p)
    return poly+[0]*(length-len(poly))


def modular_product(builder, U, L, R, label, final_zero=False):
    """Expose all bounded remainder/quotient coefficients, even when they are zero."""
    p = builder.p
    k = len(U)-1
    q.require(k >= 1 and len(L) == len(R) == k, 'modular product arity')
    uv = [builder.value(x) for x in U]
    lv = [builder.value(x) for x in L]
    rv = [builder.value(x) for x in R]
    quotient, remainder = q.divrem(q.mul(lv, rv, p), uv, p)
    # k=1 has no quotient variables; the numerical quotient is the zero polynomial.
    qv = pad([] if k == 1 else quotient, k-1, p)
    pv = pad(remainder, k, p)
    P = [{} for _ in range(k)] if final_zero else [builder.aux(label+'.P'+str(i), pv[i]) for i in range(k)]
    Q = [builder.aux(label+'.Q'+str(i), qv[i]) for i in range(k-1)]
    LR = ir.polynomial_product(L, R, p)
    UQ = ir.polynomial_product(U, Q, p) if Q else [{} for _ in range(2*k-1)]
    for i in range(2*k-1):
        builder.eq(label+'.coefficient'+str(i), ir.sub(ir.sub(LR[i], P[i] if i < k else {}, p), UQ[i], p))
    event('modular_product_certificate')
    return P


def nilpotent_square_block(k, p, a, b, U=None, C=None):
    """Return explicit IR plus a supplied-C assignment (not necessarily satisfying)."""
    curve_parameters(p, a, b)
    q.require(type(k) is int and 0 <= k <= 5, 'supported degree k0..5')
    U = [0]*k+[1] if U is None else U
    q.require(type(U) is list and len(U) == k+1 and U[-1] == 1, 'monic degree-k input')
    for x in U:
        q.scalar(x, p)
    C = pad([] if C is None else C, k, p)
    B = ir.Builder(p, a, b, 'nilpotent', k)
    u = [B.input('u'+str(i), U[i]) for i in range(k)]+[ir.constant(1, p)]
    if not k:
        return B.export()
    c = [B.aux('C'+str(i), C[i]) for i in range(k)]
    if k == 1:
        v = B.aux('v', U[0]*U[0] % p)
        F = B.aux('F', (-U[0]**3-a*U[0]+b) % p)
        B.eq('evaluation.square', ir.sub(v, ir.mul(u[0], u[0], p), p))
        B.eq('evaluation.cubic', ir.add(p, F, ir.mul(u[0], v, p), ir.scale(u[0], a, p), ir.constant(-b, p)))
        B.eq('ordinate.square', ir.sub(ir.mul(c[0], c[0], p), F, p))
        return B.export()
    if k == 2:
        qvalue = -U[1] % p
        qq = B.aux('f.q', qvalue)
        F1 = B.aux('f.F1', (a-U[0]-U[1]*qvalue) % p)
        F0 = B.aux('f.F0', (b-U[0]*qvalue) % p)
        B.eq('f.degree2', ir.add(p, qq, u[1]))
        B.eq('f.degree1', ir.add(p, F1, u[0], ir.mul(u[1], qq, p), ir.constant(-a, p)))
        B.eq('f.degree0', ir.add(p, F0, ir.mul(u[0], qq, p), ir.constant(-b, p)))
        F = [F0, F1]
    elif k == 3:
        F = [ir.sub(ir.constant(b, p), u[0], p), ir.sub(ir.constant(a, p), u[1], p), ir.scale(u[2], -1, p)]
    else:
        F = [ir.constant(x, p) for x in [b, a, 0, 1]+[0]*(k-4)]
    W = modular_product(B, u, c, c, 'C2')
    D = [ir.sub(x, y, p) for x, y in zip(W, F)]
    if k == 2:
        modular_product(B, u, D, D, 'D2zero', True)
    else:
        S = modular_product(B, u, D, D, 'D2')
        if k == 3:
            modular_product(B, u, S, D, 'D3zero', True)
        elif k == 4:
            modular_product(B, u, S, S, 'D4zero', True)
        else:
            T = modular_product(B, u, S, S, 'D4')
            modular_product(B, u, T, D, 'D5zero', True)
    return B.export()


def linear_B_square_block(p, a, b, mode, A=None, B=None, beta=0):
    curve_parameters(p, a, b)
    q.require(mode in ('guard', 'slack'), 'guard or slack mode')
    aa = pad([0] if A is None else A, 4, p)
    bb = pad([0, 1] if B is None else B, 2, p)
    q.require(bb[1] != 0, 'linear B stratum')
    q.scalar(beta, p)
    zval = q.inv(bb[1], p)
    alpha = -bb[0]*zval % p
    q1v = (aa[3]*alpha+aa[2]) % p
    q2v = (q1v*alpha+aa[1]) % p
    cv = (q2v*alpha+aa[0]) % p
    fv = (alpha**3+a*alpha+b) % p
    E = ir.Builder(p, a, b, mode, None)
    av = [E.input('A'+str(i), v) for i, v in enumerate(aa)]
    bv = [E.input('b'+str(i), v) for i, v in enumerate(bb)]
    z = E.aux('z', zval); x = E.aux('alpha', alpha)
    q1 = E.aux('q1', q1v); q2 = E.aux('q2', q2v)
    c = E.aux('c', cv); v = E.aux('v', alpha*alpha % p); F = E.aux('F', fv)
    E.eq('linear.inverse', ir.add(p, ir.mul(bv[1], z, p), ir.constant(-1, p)))
    E.eq('linear.root', ir.add(p, ir.mul(bv[1], x, p), bv[0]))
    E.eq('A.horner1', ir.sub(ir.sub(q1, ir.mul(av[3], x, p), p), av[2], p))
    E.eq('A.horner2', ir.sub(ir.sub(q2, ir.mul(q1, x, p), p), av[1], p))
    E.eq('A.value', ir.sub(ir.sub(c, ir.mul(q2, x, p), p), av[0], p))
    E.eq('f.square', ir.sub(v, ir.mul(x, x, p), p))
    E.eq('f.value', ir.sub(ir.sub(ir.sub(F, ir.mul(x, v, p), p), ir.scale(x, a, p), p), ir.constant(b, p), p))
    if mode == 'guard':
        e = E.aux('e', int(cv == 0))
        u = E.aux('u', q.inv(cv, p) if cv else 0)
        y = E.aux('beta', 0 if cv else beta)
        E.eq('guard.inverse', ir.add(p, ir.mul(c, u, p), e, ir.constant(-1, p)))
        E.eq('guard.c', ir.mul(c, e, p))
        E.eq('guard.u', ir.mul(u, e, p))
        E.eq('guard.beta', ir.sub(y, ir.mul(e, y, p), p))
        E.eq('guard.square', ir.sub(ir.mul(y, y, p), ir.mul(e, F, p), p))
    else:
        y = E.aux('beta', beta)
        u = E.aux('u', (beta*beta-fv)*q.inv(cv, p) % p if cv else 0)
        E.eq('slack.square', ir.sub(ir.sub(ir.mul(y, y, p), F, p), ir.mul(c, u, p), p))
    return E.export()


def constant_B_block(curve, B):
    p = curve['p'];curve_parameters(p, curve['a'], curve['b'])
    q.require(type(B) is list and len(B) == 1, 'constant B representation')
    q.scalar(B[0], p);q.require(B[0] != 0, 'constant nonzero B stratum')
    E = ir.Builder(p, curve['a'], curve['b'], 'constant', None)
    c = E.input('b0', B[0]);z = E.aux('z', q.inv(B[0], p))
    E.eq('constant.inverse', ir.add(p, ir.mul(c, z, p), ir.constant(-1, p)))
    return E.export()


def interpolate_known_roots(U, points):
    p, u = q.modulus(U)
    by_x = defaultdict(set)
    for P in points:
        if P is not None:
            q.require(type(P) is list and len(P) == 2, 'supplied point pair')
            x, y = P;q.scalar(x, p);q.scalar(y, p)
            by_x[x].add(min(y, -y % p))
    q.require(all(len(ys) == 1 for ys in by_x.values()), 'consistent supplied ordinate roots')
    result = [0]
    for x, ys in sorted(by_x.items()):
        basis = [1];denominator = 1
        for xx in sorted(by_x):
            if xx != x:
                basis = q.mul(basis, [-xx % p, 1], p)
                denominator = denominator*(x-xx) % p
        result = q.add(result, q.scale(basis, next(iter(ys))*q.inv(denominator, p) % p, p), p)
        event('interpolation_distinct_root')
    return [] if len(u) == 1 else pad(result, len(u)-1, p)


def chart_identity(w):
    return {key: w[key] for key in ('curve', 'interval', 'target', 'k', 'A', 'B', 'U')}


def construct_auxiliaries_from_checked_chart(w, recovered_points, arm, beta_override=None):
    """Use supplied checked data only. Candidate block does not invoke Euler acceptance."""
    curve = w['curve'];p = curve['p'];a = curve['a'];b = curve['b']
    signed_recovery.validate_shape(curve, w['target'], w['A'], w['B'], w['U'])
    factors = projectors.recover_interval_factors(w['U'], w['interval']['t'], w['interval']['s'], w['e'])
    q.require(recovered_points == signed_recovery.recover_signed_divisor(curve, w['target'], w['A'], w['B'], w['U'], factors, w['root_lifts']), 'checked supplied signed points')
    q.require(arm in ('uniform_nilpotent_square', 'stratified_slack_with_nilpotent_zero_B', 'stratified_guard_with_nilpotent_zero_B'), 'candidate arm')
    B = w['B'];stratum = 'zero' if B == [0] else 'constant' if len(B) == 1 else 'linear'
    roots = []
    if arm == 'uniform_nilpotent_square' or stratum == 'zero':
        C = interpolate_known_roots(w['U'], recovered_points)
        block = nilpotent_square_block(w['k'], p, a, b, w['U']['coeffs'], C)
        roots = [[x, q.evaluate(C or [0], x, p)] for x, m in factors['factors']]
    elif stratum == 'constant':
        block = constant_B_block(curve, B)
    else:
        alpha = -B[0]*q.inv(B[1], p) % p
        c = q.evaluate(w['A'], alpha, p)
        beta = 0
        if not c:
            supplied = [y for x, y in w['root_lifts'] if x == alpha]
            q.require(bool(supplied), 'supplied common-root ordinate')
            beta = min(min(y, -y % p) for y in supplied)
            if beta_override is not None:
                q.scalar(beta_override, p);beta = beta_override
            roots = [[alpha, beta]]
        mode = 'guard' if 'guard' in arm else 'slack'
        block = linear_B_square_block(p, a, b, mode, w['A'], B, beta)
    recovered = signed_recovery.recover_signed_divisor(curve, w['target'], w['A'], B, w['U'], factors, roots)
    event('candidate_chart_assignment')
    return {'arm': arm, 'stratum': stratum, 'chart': chart_identity(w), 'block': block,
            'root_lifts': roots, 'recovered': recovered}

"""Recover interval factors from supplied idempotents, without root enumeration."""
import quotient as q


def column_basis(M, p):
    if not M or not M[0]:
        return [[] for _ in M]
    pivots = {}; originals = []
    for j in range(len(M[0])):
        original = [row[j] for row in M]; v = original[:]
        for i, w in sorted(pivots.items()):
            c = v[i]
            v = [(a-c*b) % p for a, b in zip(v, w)]
        i = next((i for i, a in enumerate(v) if a), None)
        if i is not None:
            c = q.inv(v[i], p); pivots[i] = [a*c % p for a in v]
            originals.append(original)
    return [[v[i] for v in originals] for i in range(len(M))]


def check_factor_certificate(U, certificate):
    p, u = q.modulus(U)
    q.require(type(certificate) is dict and set(certificate) == {'p','t','s','factors'}, 'factor certificate shape')
    q.require(certificate['p'] == p and type(certificate['p']) is int, 'factor field binding')
    t, s = certificate['t'], certificate['s']; q.interval(p,t,s)
    factors = certificate['factors']; q.require(type(factors) is list, 'factor list')
    last = -1; total = 0; product = [1]
    for pair in factors:
        q.require(type(pair) is list and len(pair) == 2, 'factor pair')
        x, m = pair; q.scalar(x,p); q.integer(m,'positive integer multiplicity',1)
        q.require(x > last, 'distinct sorted factor coordinates'); last = x
        q.require((x-t) % p < (1 << s), 'factor interval membership')
        total += m; q.require(total <= len(u)-1, 'factor degree bound')
        for _ in range(m):
            product = q.mul(product,[(-x)%p,1],p)
    q.require(total == len(u)-1 and product == u, 'independent factor product')
    return True


def recover_interval_factors(U,t,s,e):
    q.event('projector_recovery'); q.verify_quotient_witness(U,t,s,e)
    p,u = q.modulus(U); k=len(u)-1
    spaces = [([[int(i==j) for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)],0)] if k else []
    for bit,v in enumerate(e):
        columns=[q.rem([0]*j+v,u,p) for j in range(k)]
        E=[[col[i] if i<len(col) else 0 for col in columns] for i in range(k)]
        next_spaces=[]
        for V,label in spaces:
            for value in [0,1]:
                W=[[(sum(((E[i][a] if value else int(i==a)-E[i][a]))*V[a][b]
                           for a in range(k))) % p for b in range(len(V[0]))] for i in range(k)]
                B=column_basis(W,p)
                if B and B[0]:next_spaces.append((B,label+value*(1<<bit)))
        spaces=next_spaces
        q.require(sum(len(V[0]) for V,_ in spaces)==k,'projector dimension preservation')
        q.event('projector_depth'); q.event('projector_nonzero_spaces',len(spaces))
    factors=sorted([[(t+label)%p,len(V[0])] for V,label in spaces])
    certificate={'p':p,'t':t,'s':s,'factors':factors}
    check_factor_certificate(U,certificate)
    return certificate

"""Signed multiplicity recovery by valuations and norm units; no field scan."""
from collections import Counter
import quotient as q
import charts
from projectors import check_factor_certificate


def validate_shape(curve,target,A,B,U):
    p,f=q.curve_data(curve);up,u=q.modulus(U);q.require(p==up,'curve quotient field match')
    A=q.canonical(A,p);B=q.canonical(B,p);k=len(u)-1;target=charts.point(curve,target)
    spec=charts.chart_spec(curve,k,target);q.require(spec['possible'],'possible pole chart')
    if not k:
        q.require(A==[1] and B==[0],'identity chart constants');return p,f,u,spec,target
    d=spec['d']
    degA=-1 if A==[0] else len(A)-1;degB=-1 if B==[0] else len(B)-1
    if d%2==0:q.require(degA==d//2 and A[-1]==1 and (B==[0] or 2*degB+3<d),'even pole normalization')
    else:q.require(degB==(d-3)//2 and B[-1]==1 and (A==[0] or 2*degA<d),'odd pole normalization')
    N=q.sub(q.mul(A,A,p),q.mul(f,q.mul(B,B,p),p),p)
    expected=q.mul([(-target[0])%p,1],u,p) if target else u
    q.require(q.scale(N,spec['c'],p)==expected,'norm coefficient identity')
    if target:q.require((q.evaluate(A,target[0],p)-target[1]*q.evaluate(B,target[0],p))%p==0,'actual negative target zero')
    return p,f,u,spec,target


def norm_support(factors,target):
    support=dict(factors['factors'])
    if target:support[target[0]]=support.get(target[0],0)+1
    return sorted(support.items())


def recover_signed_divisor(curve,target,A,B,U,factors,root_lifts):
    q.event('signed_divisor_recovery');p,f,u,spec,target=validate_shape(curve,target,A,B,U)
    check_factor_certificate(U,factors);q.require(type(root_lifts) is list,'root lift list')
    lifts=[charts.point(curve,P,False) for P in root_lifts]
    q.require(len(set(lifts))==len(lifts),'distinct root lift records')
    if len(u)==1:return [None]*5
    divisor=Counter()
    for x,m in norm_support(factors,target):
        av,ar=q.valuation(A,x,p);bv,br=q.valuation(B,x,p);fx=q.evaluate(f,x,p)
        if fx==0:
            order=min(2*av,2*bv+1);q.require(order==m,'branch local order');divisor[(x,0)]+=m
        else:
            g=min(av,bv);q.require(type(g) is int,'finite common valuation');residual=m-2*g
            q.require(residual>=0,'nonnegative residual norm order')
            if residual:
                common=q.power([(-x)%p,1],g,p);a0=q.exact(A,common,p);b0=q.exact(B,common,p)
                bval=q.evaluate(b0,x,p);q.require(bval!=0,'nonzero sign denominator')
                beta=-q.evaluate(a0,x,p)*q.inv(bval,p)%p
                q.require(beta!=0 and beta*beta%p==fx,'ratio ordinate')
            else:
                q.require(g>0,'balanced norm root')
                beta=target[1] if target and target[0]==x else next((y for xx,y in lifts if xx==x),None)
                q.require(beta is not None,'supplied balanced square root')
                q.require(beta!=0 and beta*beta%p==fx,'balanced square root check');q.event('supplied_square_root_check')
            if g+residual:divisor[(x,beta)]+=g+residual
            if g:divisor[(x,(-beta)%p)]+=g
    q.require(sum(divisor.values())==spec['d'],'complete signed degree')
    if target:
        negative=(target[0],(-target[1])%p);q.require(divisor[negative]>=1,'signed target subtraction');divisor[negative]-=1
    points=[P for P,m in sorted(divisor.items()) for _ in range(m)]
    q.require(len(points)==len(u)-1,'residual affine degree')
    q.require(Counter(x for x,y in points)==Counter(dict(factors['factors'])),'residual coordinate multiplicities')
    q.require(charts.sum_points(curve,points)==target,'recovered group sum')
    return [list(P) for P in points]+[None]*(5-len(points))
